metadata.name: healthcare-eval-harness
metadata.description: Patient safety evaluation harness for healthcare application deployments. Automated test suites for CDSS accuracy, PHI exposure, clinical workflow integrity, and integration compliance. Blocks deployments on safety failures. Use when a healthcare deployment must be gated on patient-safety tests for CDSS accuracy, PHI exposure, and workflow integrity.
